import asyncio

async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Navigate to the homepage using relative URL
    await page.goto('/')
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Ensure page is fully loaded
    
    # Step 2: Filter links on the homepage to find posts
    links_by_type = await filter_pages_by_content_type(page, '/')
    post_links = links_by_type.get('post', [])
    
    # Step 3: Find the link with name matching the target post title
    target_post_title = "In World First, Chinese Surgeons Save Patient’s Ear With Graft Onto Foot"
    target_url = None
    for link in post_links:
        link_name = link.get('name', '')
        if target_post_title.lower() in link_name.lower():
            target_url = link.get('url')
            break
    
    if not target_url:
        # If not found in posts, search through all links
        all_links = []
        for category in links_by_type.values():
            all_links.extend(category)
        for link in all_links:
            link_name = link.get('name', '')
            if target_post_title.lower() in link_name.lower():
                target_url = link.get('url')
                break
    
    if not target_url:
        # Fallback: use search_pages_by_keyword
        search_results = await search_pages_by_keyword(page, "Chinese Surgeons")
        for result in search_results:
            if target_post_title.lower() in result.get('title', '').lower():
                target_url = result.get('url')
                break
    
    if not target_url:
        return "Post not found. Cannot proceed."
    
    # Step 4: Navigate to the post page
    await page.goto(target_url)
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await asyncio.sleep(2)
    
    # Step 5: Submit the comment
    comment_result = await submit_comment_on_page(
        page=page,
        page_url=target_url,
        comment_text="Excellent write-up!",
        commenter_name="Test User",
        commenter_email="test@example.com",
        commenter_website="",
        save_details=True
    )
    
    return comment_result
